reserveReview.rationale: USDK is an M0 extension, not an independently issued KAST liability. M0's extension and Solana documentation describe each extension as maintaining an m_vault PDA that holds the backing $M, with wrap transferring $M into the vault and unwrap burning the extension token to release it. Verified directly on chain at Solana slot 443400427 (2026-09-01T10:26:09Z): the m_ext program extaykYu5AQcDm3qZAbiDN3yp6skqn6Nssj7veUUGZw holds the USDK extension state at AiiXk9Rztiv9E72Ying8byGzvxnVmyaeunysYEmvG1NU, which records the extension mint usdkbee86pkLyRmxfFCdkyySpxRb5ndCxVsK2BkRXwX and the backing mint mzerojk9tg56ebsrEAhfkyc9VgKjTW2zDqp6C5mhjzH ($M by M0, whose scaled-UI multiplier 1.093277352384 is the M0 index propagated on chain and matches Noble's independently queried M index of 1.093272766999). The USDK m_vault token account EHNaRY1ZdtaoPVMqE3TW6pacACzEoU1e9V1ToLyavowN (authority HGXvfS2MmJ1k6aGji7u13AtaiM62w2m7egwW3o5qLqqo) held 22,255,150.855475 principal units, or 24,331,052.404180 $M at the current index, against a USDK supply of 23,939,622.844939 - 101.64% coverage by $M alone. The 2026-07-29 unwrap transaction independently shows the m_ext Unwrap instruction burning USDK and debiting that exact vault, confirming it is USDK's backing account. The complete direct claim is therefore the tracked m-m0 parent, whose own Treasury and cash collateral stays reviewed on that entry rather than being duplicated here.
